title: Expiry of Calloway Limited Home Warranty Coverage
content:
A Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage expires the day after its structural end date, when every coverage period on the home has ended; its status then becomes expired. Callbacks accepted before then continue to be handled. A transferred coverage never expires separately, because the subsequent owner's coverage carries the same dates.

| Coverage status before the structural end date passes | What happens on the day after the structural end date |
|---|---|
| Active | Expires |
| Transferred | Does not expire separately; the subsequent owner's coverage, carrying the same dates, expires in its turn |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A coverage whose structural end date is 14 March 2034 expires on 15 March 2034. A callback accepted on 1 March 2034 continues to be handled after the expiry.
